column1: # Static source inventory for map caption branches 0/7/8 and item clouds; not runtime output.
# item-caption-dispatch continues through the separate unwind fragment at 0x140c6571d..0x140c65f0a.
# Native vtable +0x5e8 supplies descriptions; +0x5f0 supplies optional articles.
# Ordinary type/material/RAW slots route through 0x140a82c10; body components through 0x140ca1aa0.
# Name/material/body-part slots are dynamic; their finite RAW vocabularies and composition rules live in data/runtime/rulesets/zh-Hans.
# Inline skeleton/body-part literals are retained in data/extracted/corpse-caption-sources.tsv; designation glyphs share src/item_designation.h.
# Rock 0xca0040: icicle, quality-marked sharp + complete material, small + complete material + rock, or a precious material alone.
# Slab 0xca0870: complete memorial item + to + personal name or a + unnamed caste/species.
# Book 0xca0bd0: written title + parenthesized complete codex description, including material-bound codex/codices; c65450 owns title-only copies.

# Cage 0xca4420: item and building variants share data/runtime/rulesets/zh-Hans/items/cage.toml; inline cage-kind and sex-marker forms are also retained in data/extracted/map-hover-building-sources.tsv.
